temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with Keith for several days. When Keith asks if he upset her, Elizabeth says no and explains she is dealing with personal stuff, apologizing if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth denies being upset with him and attributes her curtness to personal stress rather than anger at him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and consider offering Elizabeth support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers Elizabeth support and suggests a coffee break. Elizabeth accepts and thanks him, saying a coffee break sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not angry with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth accepts his offer of support and a coffee break, showing she is receptive to his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth is open to his support and willing to spend time talking.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To have the coffee break with Elizabeth, listen to her, and support her through her stress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests professional help. Elizabeth replies that she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is under severe personal stress, and he thinks professional help might benefit her, though he is worried about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: After Keith suggests professional help, Elizabeth does not reject the idea outright; she says she has considered it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth may be open to professional help, but she is hesitant and ambivalent about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently encourage or support Elizabeth without pressuring her or making her uncomfortable.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the professional-help suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn. Keith apologizes if he overstepped. Elizabeth says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion might have embarrassed Elizabeth, and he feels regretful about possibly overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth tells him he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern, though she has a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes he did not offend Elizabeth; she appreciates his support but needs time to process things.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure Elizabeth of his support without pushing her, while giving her space to think.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative of Keith's concern. Keith says he is glad they talked and that he is always available. Elizabeth thanks him, says it means a lot, and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth appreciates his support but is still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth confirms she values his support, feels better knowing she has it, and appears more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support, feels more comfortable around him, and that their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks together.
